contents.name: Scalar fold hypotheses, local curve, and branch-side analysis.
Generic Hopf normal form, removal of quadratic and nonresonant cubic terms, and the multilinear first-Lyapunov coefficient formula.
Two-dimensional supercritical and subcritical cubic models and their radial stability.
Two-dimensional supercritical and subcritical cubic models and their radial stability.
The stated center-manifold theorem and parameter extension; the book explicitly defers the center-manifold proof, which is supplied locally in this batch.
Hopf hypotheses, side, and stability cross-check; the full-dimensional proof and strict enclosure semantics are supplied locally.
The degenerate zero-cubic case is distinguished from the nondegenerate theorem.
The derivative of the Poincare return map transfers hyperbolic multipliers to orbital stability.

sources.retrieval_history_note: The full author-hosted PDF was downloaded directly and its complete text extracted with MuPDF. Section 3.5 supplies the planar normal-form algebra and coefficient; Chapter 5 states the center-manifold result but explicitly does not prove it. That missing proof is authored locally.

sources.title: J. E. Marsden and M. McCracken, The Hopf Bifurcation and Its Applications, Springer-Verlag, 1976
sources.locator: Section 2, printed pp. 27–49; Sections 3B–3C, printed pp. 91–104. The complete 424-page text was fetched and the cited sections inspected.

contents.name: Complete finite-dimensional center-manifold graph construction, local invariance, and flow version.
Analytic Hopf existence proof and center-theorem connection; the source uses a periodic-function-space reduction, while this batch proves the center-manifold route locally.
Stability analysis for the periodic branch and the role of transverse modes.
Poincare sections and local periodic-orbit terminology.
Return-map stability implies stability or instability of the periodic orbit as a set.

sources.retrieval_history_note: The full Caltech-hosted Springer text was fetched directly and extracted with MuPDF. Section 2 includes a complete graph-transform proof of the center-manifold theorem; Section 3C gives an independent analytic Hopf proof under its stated nonresonance hypotheses; Section 3B treats stability. The current local proof retains the stricter plan hypotheses and proves its own center reduction.

recovery_attempts.outcome: Full 9,811,722-byte, 424-page PDF fetched and relevant sections inspected.
